title: Advance approved cargohold gates and claim whole-service implementation

acceptance_criteria.description: Approved reference contract and completed plan advance only the contracted and implementing gates; whole-service task has bounded candidate scope.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Machine state/transition validation; no candidate compatibility or availability claimed.

evidence.command: Machine state and scoped adjacent transition checks pass at each gate: inventoried to contracted, then contracted to implementing. Approved contract and completed plan retained; queued implementation limited to additive candidate/task/changelog paths.

handoff: Implementation gates advanced legally with no availability or compatibility claim. User disposition resolved; candidate task ready.
